WITH sales AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) gross_net, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN 0 ELSE f.net_amount END) nonstaff
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' GROUP BY 1),
ret AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) ret_net, count(*) n_ret, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN r.refund_net ELSE 0 END) ret_staff
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' GROUP BY 1),
rpt AS (
  SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales_before_returns) rpt_before, sum(returns_net) rpt_ret, sum(net_sales) rpt_net, count(*) n_days
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT sales.store_id, sales.gross_net, sales.nonstaff, ret.ret_net, ret.n_ret, ret.ret_staff, rpt.rpt_before, rpt.rpt_ret, rpt.rpt_net, rpt.n_days

SELECT d.calendar_date, d.is_trading_day, d.holiday_name, d.fiscal_period_label, (SELECT sum(net_sales) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r WHERE r.business_date=d.calendar_date AND r.store_id=125) s125, (SELECT sum(net_sales) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r WHERE r.business_date=d.calendar_date AND r.store_id=115) s115
FROM dim_date d WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' ORDER BY 1

WITH per AS (
  SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date AS p_start, period_end_date AS p_end
  FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period = 2
),
stores AS (
  SELECT store_id, max(CASE WHEN is_current THEN store_name END) AS store_name
  FROM dim_store WHERE store_id < 900 GROUP BY store_id
),
sales AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) AS sales_net
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN per ON f.sale_date BETWEEN per.p_start AND per.p_end
  WHERE s.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY s.store_id
),
refunds AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) AS refunds_net
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  JOIN per ON r.return_date BETWEEN per.p_start AND per.p_end
  WHERE s.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY s.store_id
),
trading AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, count(*) AS trading_days
  FROM stores st
  JOIN per ON true
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date BETWEEN per.p_start AND per.p_end AND d.is_trading_day
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id AND d.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date)
  GROUP BY st.store_id
),
agg AS (
  SELECT per.fiscal_year, per.fiscal_period, st.store_id, st.store_name,
         round(sa.sales_net - coalesce(rf.refunds_net, 0), 2) AS net_sales,
         tr.trading_days,
         round((sa.sales_net - coalesce(rf.refunds_net, 0)) / tr.trading_days, 2) AS net_sales_per_trading_day
  FROM stores st
  JOIN sales sa ON sa.store_id = st.store_id
  LEFT JOIN refunds rf ON rf.store_id = st.store_id
  JOIN trading tr ON tr.store_id = st.store_id
  CROSS JOIN per
)
SELECT rank() OVER (ORDER BY net_sales_per_trading_day DESC) AS rank, fiscal_year, fiscal_period, store_id, store_name, net_sales, trading_days, net_sales_per_trading_day,
       rank() OVER (ORDER BY net_sales DESC) AS rank_on_total
FROM agg ORDER BY rank, store_id
